title: Template:Coins
text: Turns an amount of copper ("Coin") into Gold, Silver and Copper with icons. Parts that are zero are left out. 100 Copper = 1 Silver, 100 Silver = 1 Gold (so 10000 Copper = 1 Gold). Needs the images File:Gold.png, File:Silver.png and File:Copper.png. Usage {{Coins|100}} → 1 Silver {{Coins|12345}} → 1 Gold 23 Silver 45 Copper {{Coins|10005}} → 1 Gold 5 Copper
html:
Turns an amount of copper ("Coin") into Gold, Silver and Copper with icons. Parts that are zero are left out. 100 Copper = 1 Silver, 100 Silver = 1 Gold (so 10000 Copper = 1 Gold). Needs the images File:Gold.png, File:Silver.png and File:Copper.png.

Usage 

{{Coins|100}}      → 1 Silver
{{Coins|12345}}    → 1 Gold 23 Silver 45 Copper
{{Coins|10005}}    → 1 Gold 5 Copper
wikitext:
{{#ifeq:{{#expr:floor(({{{1|0}}} round 0)/10000)}}|0||{{#expr:floor(({{{1|0}}} round 0)/10000)}}[[File:Gold.png|24px|middle]] }}{{#ifeq:{{#expr:floor(({{{1|0}}} round 0)/100) mod 100}}|0||{{#expr:floor(({{{1|0}}} round 0)/100) mod 100}}[[File:Silver.png|24px|middle]] }}{{#ifeq:{{#expr:({{{1|0}}} round 0) mod 100}}|0||{{#expr:({{{1|0}}} round 0) mod 100}}[[File:Copper.png|24px|middle]]}} Turns an amount of copper ("Coin") into Gold, Silver and Copper with icons. Parts that are zero are left out. 100 Copper = 1 Silver, 100 Silver = 1 Gold (so 10000 Copper = 1 Gold). Needs the images File:Gold.png, File:Silver.png and File:Copper.png. '''Usage''' 
{{Coins|100}}      → 1 Silver
{{Coins|12345}}    → 1 Gold 23 Silver 45 Copper
{{Coins|10005}}    → 1 Gold 5 Copper
